γονυπετέω, -ῶ) (γόνυ, πίπτω);

εἰσ-πηδάω, -ῶ 
 [in LXX: Amo.5:19 (בּוֹא), Da TH Sus 1:26* ;] 
to spring in, rush in: Act.14:14 (Rec.), Act.16:29 (for exx. from π., see MM, Exp., xii).†
 (AS)

ἔλαιον, -ου, τό 
 [in LXX chiefly for שֶׁמֶן ;] 
olive-oil: Luk.16:6, Rev.6:6 18:13; for lamps, Mat.25:3-4, 8; for healing, Mrk.6:13, Luk.10:34, Jhn.5:14; for anointing at feasts, Luk.7:46, Heb.1:9" (LXX) .†
 SYN.: μύρον, ointment, see Tr., Syn., 135 (AS)

ἐπι-μελεομαι, -οῦμαι 
 [in LXX: Gen.44:21 (עַיִן שׂוּם) I Est.6:27, Pro.27:25, Sir.30:25, 1Ma.11:37 * ;] 
to take care of: with genitive, Luk.10:34-35, 1Ti.3:5.†
 (AS)

εὐλάβεια, -ας, ἡ
 (εὐλαβής), [in LXX: Jer.22:24 (דְּאָגָה), Pro.28:14, Wis.17:8 * ;] 
__1. caution, discretion (Soph., Plat., al.). 
 __2. In later Gk. (Diod., Plut., al.), also reverence, godly fear: Heb.5:7 12:28.†
 (AS)

κάμπτω 
 [in LXX chiefly for כָּרַע, 4Ki.1:13, 2Ch.29:29, Isa.45:24 (23), al. ;] 
to bend, bow: with accusative of thing(s), γόνυ, τὰ γ.; with dative of person(s), τῇ Βάαλ, Rom.11:4 (LXX); πρὸς τ. πατέρα, Eph.3:14; by meton., πᾶν γόνυ for πᾶς, Rom.14:11 (LXX) Php.2:10 (cf. ἀνα-, συν-κάμπτω).†
 (AS)

παίζω
 (παῖς), [in LXX: Gen.21:9 26:8, Exo.32:6 (צָחַק pi.); and more frequently (Jdg.16:25, al.) for (שָׂחַק pi. ;] 
prop., to play as a child, hence, generally, to play (as with singing and dancing) : 1Co.10:7 (LXX) (cf. ἐμ-παίζω).†
 (AS)

πέρυσι 
 adv. (πέρας), 
last year, a year ago: ἀπὸ π. (as in π. see Deiss., BS, 221; LAE, 70), 2Co.8:10 9:2.†
 (AS)

πλουτίζω
 (πλοῦτος), [in LXX chiefly for עָשַׁר hi. ;] 
to make rich, enrich: with accusative of person(s), pass., 2Co.9:11. Metaphorical, of spiritual riches, with accusative: of person(s), 2Co.6:10; before ἐν, pass., 1Co.1:5.†
 (AS)

σίδηρος, -ου, ὁ 
 [in LXX chiefly for בַּרְזֶל ;] 
iron: Rev.18:12.†
 (AS)

σύν (old Att. ξύν), 
 prep. with dative, 
expressing association, fellowship and inclusion. It gradually gave way to μετά, with genitive (cf. LS, see word; Bl., §41, 3), and is therefore comparatively infrequent in NT, being rare in Mat.4, Mrk.6, Jhn.3, and elsewhere (exx. Jas.1:11, 2Pe.1:18) only in Lk (Gosp. and Ac) and Paul. With, together with: of companionship and association, Luk.2:13, Jhn.21:3, Act.10:23, al.; εἶναι σύν τινι, Luk.7:12, Act.4:13, Php.1:23, al.; of partisanship, Act.4:13; οἱ σύν τινι, of attendants, companions or colleagues, Mrk.2:26, Luk.5:9, Act.5:17, al.; of assistance, ἡ χάρις τ. θεοῦ σὺν ἐμοί, 1Co.15:10; of two or more things together, almost = καί, Luk.23:11, Act.3:4 10:2 14:5 23:25, Eph.3:18; σὺν Χριστῷ ζῆν, 2Co.13:4; besides (FlJ, LXX), σὺν πᾶσι τούτοις, Luk.24:21. In composition: with (συνχαίρω), together (συνωδίνω), altogether (συντελέω) 
 (AS)

ὑφαντός, -ή, -όν
 (ὑφαίνω), [in LXX chiefly for חָשַׁב ;] 
woven: Jhn.19:23.†
 ὑφαίνω, 
 [in LXX for אָרַג, etc. ;] 
to weave: Luk.12:27, T, WH, mg.†
 (AS)

χοῖνιξ, -ικος, ἡ 
 [in LXX: Eze.45:10-11 (בַּת) * ;] 
a chænix, a dry measure of rather less than a quart: Rev.6:6 (EV, measure).†
 (AS)

ἀπό-θεσις, -εως, ἡ
 (ἀποτίθημι), 
a putting away: 1Pe.3:21, 2Pe.1:14.†
 (AS)

Βαρι-ησοῦς, -οῦ, ὁ (Aram. בַּר־יֵשׁוּעַ, son of Joshua), 
 Bar-Jesus: Act.13:6 (see: Ἐλύμας).†
